title: Computational Optimal Transport
tldr_zh: 计算 OT 标准教材，10 章覆盖离散 OT、对偶、Sinkhorn、半离散、动态形式、barycenter，从零到能跑代码
tldr_en: Standard computational-OT textbook: discrete OT, duality, Sinkhorn, semi-discrete, Benamou-Brenier dynamics, barycenters, with three-layer exposition and code.
key_numbers: 10 chapters, 209 pages; FnT ML vol. 11(5-6) pp. 355-607 (2019)
Thm 2.1 Brenier: unique plan (Id,T)#alpha with T = grad of convex phi = |x|^2/2 - f (Sec. 2.5)
Prop. 3.4: extremal couplings have at most n+m-1 nonzeros (Sec. 3.4)
